address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the Multiplexer. Defaults to `0x70`.

*See also: [TCA9548A I²C Multiplexer](https://esphome.io/components/tca9548a#configuration-variables)*

bus_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this virtual I2C Bus.

*See also: [TCA9548A I²C Multiplexer](https://esphome.io/components/tca9548a#configuration-variables)*

channel.docs:
The channel (0-7) to use for this virtual I2C Bus.

*See also: [TCA9548A I²C Multiplexer](https://esphome.io/components/tca9548a#configuration-variables)*

channels.docs:
The I²C Bus Channels

*See also: [TCA9548A I²C Multiplexer](https://esphome.io/components/tca9548a#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
The I²C Bus ID Defaults to `false`

*See also: [TCA9548A I²C Multiplexer](https://esphome.io/components/tca9548a#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this TCA9548A component.

*See also: [TCA9548A I²C Multiplexer](https://esphome.io/components/tca9548a#configuration-variables)*
